summary.text: Alexander Kolodin, a Republican state representative and attorney, lost the November 3, 2026 election for secretary of state of Arizona to Adrian Fontes.
He sponsored a voter-ID bill that went before voters on the November ballot, and during the campaign he said he would bring transparency and accountability to the Secretary of State's office.

paragraphs.text: He earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University and a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, founded the Kolodin Law Group, and practiced law privately before seeking elected office.
He has represented District 3 in the Arizona House of Representatives since taking office on January 9, 2023.
He won the July 21, 2026 Republican primary for Secretary of State over former Arizona GOP chair Gina Swoboda.
He received 43.6% of the vote to Adrian Fontes's 54.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
